private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p
private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h
private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)
private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

/-- This occurrence pushes TW before copying the cache. -/
theorem ax_stack_push_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)

      liveValue (number cacheRestore.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [show cacheCopyShape.sourceIndex = cacheReg from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.firstIndex = twReg from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.secondIndex = s1Reg from rfl, h1, zero_add, h, g]
      using copy_run cacheCopyShape file
  have hgs1 : regValue g s1Reg = h := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g cacheReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg cacheReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg cacheReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hf : put cacheReg h (put s1Reg 0 g) =

    intro i
    have h1' : regValue file (8 : Fin 9) = 0 := h1
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i

    by_cases hi7 : i = (7 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg, h1']
    simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi7, Ne.symm hi8]
  have hrestore : controlRun (3 * h + 1)
      (liveValue (number cacheRestore.test : V) g) =

      show cacheRestore.targetIndex = cacheReg from rfl, hgs1, hgp, zero_add, hf]
      using move_run cacheRestore g
  rw [show 7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2 = (4 * h + 1) + (3 * h + 1) by
      dsimp only [h]; ring, controlRun_add, hcopy, hrestore]

/-- The second AX push changes exactly the two working formula fields. -/
def cachePushFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem cachePushFile_other (file : V) (p : Fin 9)
    (ht : p ≠ twReg) (hs : p ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (cachePushFile file) p = regValue file p := by
  rw [cachePushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg p ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg p hs.symm]

/-- Actual cache/P2 push for arbitrary internal input values and runtime. -/
theorem ax_cache_push_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number nextPush : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (cachePushFile file) := by
  let g := pushFile file
  have hg1 : regValue g s1Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgc : regValue g cacheReg = regValue file cacheReg := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg cacheReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg cacheReg (by decide)]
  have hf : put twReg (regValue g twReg + regValue g cacheReg) g = cachePushFile file := by
    rw [hgtw, hgc, zero_add]
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg, Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0]
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hp⟩ := ax_stack_push_run file h1 h2
  have ht := ax_cache_copy_run g hg1
  rw [hf, hgc] at ht
  refine ⟨tp + (7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2),
    le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hp]
  exact ht

/-- The two parameter pushes save the old top followed by parameter1. -/
def twoParametersFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file p1Reg)
      (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg))) file)

private theorem cachePushFile_paramPushFile (file : V) :
    cachePushFile (paramPushFile file) = twoParametersFile file := by
  apply file_ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
  · subst i
    simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg]
  by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
  · subst i
    simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg]
  simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg,
    Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0]

/-- Composition with the checked first AX push, still before the GEN constructor. -/
theorem ax_two_parameters_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number axEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (twoParametersFile file) := by
  have h1' : regValue (paramPushFile file) s1Reg = 0 := by
    rw [paramPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have h2' : regValue (paramPushFile file) s2Reg = 0 := by
    rw [paramPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg s2Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s2Reg (by decide)]
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, hr1⟩ := ax_prefix_run file h1 h2
  obtain ⟨t2, _, hr2⟩ := ax_cache_push_run (paramPushFile file) h1' h2'
  refine ⟨t1 + t2, le_trans ht1 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hr1, hr2, cachePushFile_paramPushFile]

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXCachePush254

section Model
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p
private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h
private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)
private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

/-- This occurrence pushes TW before copying the cache. -/
theorem ax_stack_push_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number nextPush : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cacheCopy : V) (pushFile file) := by
  exact push_run initialPush file h1 h2

/-- Exactly 7*cache+2 instructions; only scratch1 must initially be zero. -/
theorem ax_cache_copy_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) :
    controlRun (7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2)
      (liveValue (number cacheCopy : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file) := by
  let h := regValue file cacheReg
  let g := put s1Reg h (put twReg (regValue file twReg + h) (put cacheReg 0 file))
  have hcopy : controlRun (4 * h + 1) (liveValue (number cacheCopy : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cacheRestore.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [show cacheCopyShape.test = cacheCopy from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.exit = cacheRestore.test from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.sourceIndex = cacheReg from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.firstIndex = twReg from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.secondIndex = s1Reg from rfl, h1, zero_add, h, g]
      using copy_run cacheCopyShape file
  have hgs1 : regValue g s1Reg = h := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g cacheReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg cacheReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg cacheReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hf : put cacheReg h (put s1Reg 0 g) =
      put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have h1' : regValue file (8 : Fin 9) = 0 := h1
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi7 : i = (7 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg, h1']
    simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi7, Ne.symm hi8]
  have hrestore : controlRun (3 * h + 1)
      (liveValue (number cacheRestore.test : V) g) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file) := by
    simpa only [show cacheRestore.exit = cachePop from rfl,
      show cacheRestore.sourceIndex = s1Reg from rfl,
      show cacheRestore.targetIndex = cacheReg from rfl, hgs1, hgp, zero_add, hf]
      using move_run cacheRestore g
  rw [show 7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2 = (4 * h + 1) + (3 * h + 1) by
      dsimp only [h]; ring, controlRun_add, hcopy, hrestore]

/-- The second AX push changes exactly the two working formula fields. -/
def cachePushFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem cachePushFile_other (file : V) (p : Fin 9)
    (ht : p ≠ twReg) (hs : p ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (cachePushFile file) p = regValue file p := by
  rw [cachePushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg p ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg p hs.symm]

/-- Actual cache/P2 push for arbitrary internal input values and runtime. -/
theorem ax_cache_push_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number nextPush : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (cachePushFile file) := by
  let g := pushFile file
  have hg1 : regValue g s1Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgc : regValue g cacheReg = regValue file cacheReg := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg cacheReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg cacheReg (by decide)]
  have hf : put twReg (regValue g twReg + regValue g cacheReg) g = cachePushFile file := by
    rw [hgtw, hgc, zero_add]
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg, Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0]
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hp⟩ := ax_stack_push_run file h1 h2
  have ht := ax_cache_copy_run g hg1
  rw [hf, hgc] at ht
  refine ⟨tp + (7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2),
    le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hp]
  exact ht

/-- The two parameter pushes save the old top followed by parameter1. -/
def twoParametersFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file p1Reg)
      (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg))) file)

private theorem cachePushFile_paramPushFile (file : V) :
    cachePushFile (paramPushFile file) = twoParametersFile file := by
  apply file_ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
  · subst i
    simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg]
  by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
  · subst i
    simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg]
  simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg,
    Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0]

/-- Composition with the checked first AX push, still before the GEN constructor. -/
theorem ax_two_parameters_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number axEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (twoParametersFile file) := by
  have h1' : regValue (paramPushFile file) s1Reg = 0 := by
    rw [paramPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have h2' : regValue (paramPushFile file) s2Reg = 0 := by
    rw [paramPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg s2Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s2Reg (by decide)]
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, hr1⟩ := ax_prefix_run file h1 h2
  obtain ⟨t2, _, hr2⟩ := ax_cache_push_run (paramPushFile file) h1' h2'
  refine ⟨t1 + t2, le_trans ht1 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hr1, hr2, cachePushFile_paramPushFile]

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXCachePush254

variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p
private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h
private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)
private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

/-- This occurrence pushes TW before copying the cache. -/
theorem ax_stack_push_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number nextPush : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cacheCopy : V) (pushFile file) := by
  exact push_run initialPush file h1 h2

/-- Exactly 7*cache+2 instructions; only scratch1 must initially be zero. -/
theorem ax_cache_copy_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) :
    controlRun (7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2)
      (liveValue (number cacheCopy : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file) := by
  let h := regValue file cacheReg
  let g := put s1Reg h (put twReg (regValue file twReg + h) (put cacheReg 0 file))
  have hcopy : controlRun (4 * h + 1) (liveValue (number cacheCopy : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cacheRestore.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [show cacheCopyShape.sourceIndex = cacheReg from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.firstIndex = twReg from rfl,
      show cacheCopyShape.secondIndex = s1Reg from rfl, h1, zero_add, h, g]
      using copy_run cacheCopyShape file
  have hgs1 : regValue g s1Reg = h := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g cacheReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg cacheReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg cacheReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hf : put cacheReg h (put s1Reg 0 g) =
      put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have h1' : regValue file (8 : Fin 9) = 0 := h1
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi7 : i = (7 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg, h1']
    simp [read_put, g, h, twReg, cacheReg, s1Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi7, Ne.symm hi8]
  have hrestore : controlRun (3 * h + 1)
      (liveValue (number cacheRestore.test : V) g) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file) := by
    simpa only [show cacheRestore.sourceIndex = s1Reg from rfl,
      show cacheRestore.targetIndex = cacheReg from rfl, hgs1, hgp, zero_add, hf]
      using move_run cacheRestore g
  rw [show 7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2 = (4 * h + 1) + (3 * h + 1) by
      dsimp only [h]; ring, controlRun_add, hcopy, hrestore]

/-- The second AX push changes exactly the two working formula fields. -/
def cachePushFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem cachePushFile_other (file : V) (p : Fin 9)
    (ht : p ≠ twReg) (hs : p ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (cachePushFile file) p = regValue file p := by
  rw [cachePushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg p ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg p hs.symm]

/-- Actual cache/P2 push for arbitrary internal input values and runtime. -/
theorem ax_cache_push_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number nextPush : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (cachePushFile file) := by
  let g := pushFile file
  have hg1 : regValue g s1Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgc : regValue g cacheReg = regValue file cacheReg := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg cacheReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg cacheReg (by decide)]
  have hf : put twReg (regValue g twReg + regValue g cacheReg) g = cachePushFile file := by
    rw [hgtw, hgc, zero_add]
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    simp [read_put, g, pushFile, cachePushFile, twReg, wsReg, Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0]
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hp⟩ := ax_stack_push_run file h1 h2
  have ht := ax_cache_copy_run g hg1
  rw [hf, hgc] at ht
  refine ⟨tp + (7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2),
    le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hp]
  exact ht

/-- The two parameter pushes save the old top followed by parameter1. -/
def twoParametersFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file p1Reg)
      (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg))) file)

private theorem cachePushFile_paramPushFile (file : V) :
    cachePushFile (paramPushFile file) = twoParametersFile file := by
  apply file_ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
  · subst i
    simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg]
  by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
  · subst i
    simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg]
  simp [read_put, cachePushFile, paramPushFile, twoParametersFile, twReg, wsReg, cacheReg,
    Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0]

/-- Composition with the checked first AX push, still before the GEN constructor. -/
theorem ax_two_parameters_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number axEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (twoParametersFile file) := by
  have h1' : regValue (paramPushFile file) s1Reg = 0 := by
    rw [paramPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have h2' : regValue (paramPushFile file) s2Reg = 0 := by
    rw [paramPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg s2Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s2Reg (by decide)]
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, hr1⟩ := ax_prefix_run file h1 h2
  obtain ⟨t2, _, hr2⟩ := ax_cache_push_run (paramPushFile file) h1' h2'
  refine ⟨t1 + t2, le_trans ht1 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hr1, hr2, cachePushFile_paramPushFile]

end Model

    rw [if_pos rfl]

  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

# Internal AX cache/P2 push

`ArithmeticControlAXCachePush254` executes the actual second AX parameter push, from literal catalogue control 67 to 93. For any model of IΣ₁ and any internal nine-register file with zero scratch registers, it produces TW = old cache/P2 and WS = `cantor(old TW, old WS)`. Every other register is preserved. The cache-copy tail needs only scratch1 = 0 and has the exact internal clock `7 * cache + 2`.

The module also composes this result with the checked first AX push. Starting at control 41, the resulting TW is the old cache and WS is `cantor(old P1, cantor(old TW, old WS))`. These indices name source-program instructions, not binary states. Runtime witnesses and input values may be nonstandard. Existing generic Push, Copy, Move and Pair contracts supply the loop arguments; no new induction or larger proof limit was introduced.

The guarded second attempt passed the source and audit: 8 named axiom probes, 12 typed callers, and zero warnings. The first attempt failed because two `simpa` calls did not normalize three literal control aliases. Its source, audit, executed guard, log and result are retained alongside the three explicit `rfl` equalities used for the successful repair. The earlier final-newline normalization and original uncompiled draft are also preserved. Publication packaging performed no proof replay.

The guard reuses the exact AXPrefix PASS record and its 99 imported project providers, six explicit external boundaries and two toolchain boundaries. It builds only this source and its audit with a shared 120-second deadline, `-j1 -M4096`, and default proof limits. Its inherited arithmetic binary transport remains the Perm252 transport. This result advances the register interpreter shared with the 246-state target; it does not establish an internal 246 binary transport, the GEN constructor, the remaining AX suffix, or the full PA consistency endpoint.

After installing the packet, prepare the exact maintained defaults without compiling:

```bash
python3 -B Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/check_arithmetic_control_ax_cache_push254.py \
  --repo "$PWD" \
  --dependency-root /home/codex/src/Proofs \
  --ax-prefix-evidence "$PWD/Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-ax-prefix254-verification.json" \
  --output /tmp/zfc-ax-cache-push-maintained-prepared \
  --prepare-only
```

A proof replay uses the same command with a fresh empty output directory and without `--prepare-only`. Preparation retains the required parent and dependency arguments, uses installed source/audit defaults, and performs no compiler or compiler-version query. Installed-default preparation is recorded separately after placement; it is not claimed by the original successful proof record.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reviewer-owned finite source parsing; does not import or execute supplied code."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re

B = Path('/tmp/zfc-ax-next-contract')
C = B / 'cache-push'
L = Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/ec20/Proofs/Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
S = C / 'ArithmeticControlAXCachePush254.lean'
A = C / 'Audit.lean'
assert sha(S) == 'd4463d1c6f8e6264637fece6ab8e973b04173f4a97704e938dc02941c73bab7d'
assert sha(A) == 'de58d3b55cf6a98d2142f8ff7544414ff1cf4e1698984f752ddc84ae3f755230'
s, audit = S.read_text(), A.read_text()
assert len(s.splitlines()) == 418 and len(audit.splitlines()) == 68
assert s.count('rw [hf, hgc] at ht') == 1
assert re.findall(r'^import (\S+)', s, re.M) == ['BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXPrefix254']
assert re.findall(r'^set_option (.+)', s, re.M) == ['autoImplicit false']
assert len(re.findall(r'^#print axioms ', audit, re.M)) == 8
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b', audit, re.M)) == 12
assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b', s + audit)

raw = (L / 'Prog254.lean').read_text()
matches = re.findall(r'^  \(\.(node|inc|decnz|brk|cont|halt)(?: (\d+))?, \.(node|inc|decnz|brk|cont|halt)(?: (\d+))?\),? -- (\d+)$', raw, re.M)
rows = {int(n): ((x, int(a) if a else None), (y, int(b) if b else None)) for x,a,y,b,n in matches}
assert len(matches) == len(rows) == 6459 and set(rows) == set(range(6459))
leaves, todo = [], [(('node', 0), ())]
while todo:
    edge, path = todo.pop()
    if edge[0] == 'node':
        left, right = rows[edge[1]]
        todo.extend([(right, path + (True,)), (left, path + (False,))])
    else:
        leaves.append((path, edge))
assert len(leaves) == 6460
literal = (L / 'ActualTree254.lean').read_text().split('def tree : Tree :=', 1)[1].split(' theorem tree_eq', 1)[0]
tokens = iter(re.findall(r'\.node|\.leaf|\.inc|\.decnz|\.brk|\.cont|\.halt|\d+', literal))
tree_leaves, paths = [], [()]
while paths:
    path = paths.pop()
    token = next(tokens)
    if token == '.node':
        paths.extend([path + (True,), path + (False,)])
    else:
        assert token == '.leaf'
        operation = next(tokens)[1:]
        tree_leaves.append((path, (operation, None if operation == 'halt' else int(next(tokens)))))
assert next(tokens, None) is None and tree_leaves == leaves
leaf_index = {row: i for i, row in enumerate(leaves)}
def resolve(path):
    edge, bits = ('node', 0), []
    while edge[0] == 'node':
        bit = path[len(bits)] if len(bits) < len(path) else False
        bits.append(bit)
        edge = rows[edge[1]][int(bit)]
    return leaf_index[(tuple(bits), edge)]
def carry(path):
    bits = list(path)
    for n in range(len(bits)-1, -1, -1):
        if not bits[n]:
            bits[n] = True
            break
        bits[n] = False
    return bits
def strip(path, bit, count):
    bits = list(path)
    while count and bits:
        count -= bits.pop() == bit
    return bits
actual = []
for i in range(67, 94):
    path, (op, arg) = leaves[i]
    targets = {}
    if op in ('inc', 'decnz'):
        targets['positive' if op == 'decnz' else 'next'] = resolve(carry(path))
    if op == 'decnz': targets['zero'] = resolve(carry(strip(path, False, 1)))
    if op == 'cont': targets['continue'] = resolve(strip(path, True, arg))
    actual.append(dict(catalogue_index=i, represented_number=i+1, path_bits=''.join('1' if b else '0' for b in path), edge=[op,arg], targets=targets))
prior = json.loads((B / 'literal-bindings.json').read_text())
assert actual == [q for q in prior['bindings'] if 67 <= q['catalogue_index'] <= 93]
table = {q['catalogue_index']: q for q in actual}
for start, source, target, exit in [(67,1,6,70),(70,2,1,73),(79,6,1,82),(83,7,2,86),(90,6,5,93)]:
    assert table[start]['edge'] == ['decnz',source] and table[start]['targets'] == {'positive':start+1,'zero':exit}
    assert table[start+1]['edge'] == ['inc',target] and table[start+1]['targets'] == {'next':start+2}
    assert table[start+2]['edge'] == ['cont',2] and table[start+2]['targets'] == {'continue':start}
for start, source, first, second, exit in [(73,1,7,6,77),(86,5,1,6,90)]:
    assert table[start]['edge'] == ['decnz',source] and table[start]['targets'] == {'positive':start+1,'zero':exit}
    assert table[start+1]['edge'] == ['inc',first] and table[start+1]['targets'] == {'next':start+2}
    assert table[start+2]['edge'] == ['inc',second] and table[start+2]['targets'] == {'next':start+3}
    assert table[start+3]['edge'] == ['cont',3] and table[start+3]['targets'] == {'continue':start}
assert table[77]['edge'] == ['decnz',6] and table[77]['targets'] == {'positive':78,'zero':83}
assert table[78]['edge'] == ['inc',7] and table[78]['targets'] == {'next':79}
assert table[82]['edge'] == ['cont',3] and table[82]['targets'] == {'continue':73}
assert table[93]['edge'] == ['decnz',2]
report = dict(
    status='INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_ONLY_REVIEW_COMPLETE', reviewer='drop_contract',
    source=dict(path=str(S),sha256=sha(S),lines=418), audit=dict(path=str(A),sha256=sha(A),lines=68),
    plan=dict(path=str(B/'plan.md'),sha256=sha(B/'plan.md')),
    referenced_bindings=dict(path=str(B/'literal-bindings.json'),sha256=sha(B/'literal-bindings.json')),
    literal_sources={str(L/(n+'.lean')):sha(L/(n+'.lean')) for n in ['Prog254','ActualTree254','FiniteControlTable254','RegisterPath','Permutation252Frame']},
    inspected_api_sources={str(L/(n+'.lean')):sha(L/(n+'.lean')) for n in ['ArithmeticControlAXPrefix254','ArithmeticControlParamPush254','ArithmeticControlPair254','ArithmeticControlRun254']},
    full_source_and_audit_read=True, named_axiom_probes=8, typed_callers=12,
    independent_literal_parse=dict(rows=6459,leaves=6460,actual_tree_equal=True,checked_control_bindings=actual),
    resolved_prefreeze_finding='The endpoint normalization must rewrite hf before hgc; the frozen source uses rw [hf, hgc] at ht. No public statement changed.',
    conclusions=[
        'The literal67..92 sequence reaches93 through the intended five Move occurrences, two Copy occurrences and one Pair occurrence; finite shape fields match their exact source paths and successors.',
        'Copy/restore has exact internal clock7*cache+2 under only S1=0, preserving the complete file except adding cache to TW; S2 is arbitrary in this tail.',
        'The whole cache push has both scratch-zero premises and positive existential internal time. It writes TW=oldCache and WS=cantor(oldTW,oldWS), preserving every other field.',
        'Composition with the checked AXPrefix yields control41→93, TW=oldCache, WS=cantor(oldP1,cantor(oldTW,oldWS)); no GEN constructor or later AX suffix is included.',
        'All dynamic values and existential clocks have type V under the existing IΣ1 model assumptions. Reused fixed-file internal Move/Copy/Pair contracts provide all loop reasoning; no external-Nat fuel restriction or new induction is introduced.',
        'The audit exercises literal endpoints, both clean-scratch contracts, the one-scratch exact tail, retained cache/P1/PL, arbitrary unaffected coordinates, and expanded two-push composition.'],
    findings=[], compiler_invoked=False, checker_invoked=False, supplied_code_executed=False,
    reviewer_execution='Own finite source parser only; no register-machine simulation, compiler/version call, guard execution or maintained mutation.',
    limitations=['Source/API and finite-literal review only; Lean elaboration and compiled axiom sets remain for root.', 'Guard/import-provider review will be a separate receipt after its bytes freeze.', 'This is a shared arithmetic-control subroutine, not a completed internal AX, scheduler bridge or PA consistency endpoint.'])
out = C / 'review/independent-source-audit-review.json'
out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# Internal AX cache/P2 push

[ArithmeticControlAXCachePush254](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/ArithmeticControlAXCachePush254.lean) executes the actual second AX parameter push, from literal catalogue control 67 to 93. For any model of IΣ₁ and any internal nine-register file with zero scratch registers, it produces TW = old cache/P2 and WS = `cantor(old TW, old WS)`. Every other register is preserved. The cache-copy tail needs only scratch1 = 0 and has the exact internal clock `7 * cache + 2`.

The module also composes this result with the checked first AX push. Starting at control 41, the resulting TW is the old cache and WS is `cantor(old P1, cantor(old TW, old WS))`. These indices name source-program instructions, not binary states. Runtime witnesses and input values may be nonstandard. Existing generic Push, Copy, Move and Pair contracts supply the loop arguments; no new induction or larger proof limit was introduced.

The [guarded second attempt](results/arithmetic-control-ax-cache-push254-verification.json) passed the source and [audit](arithmetic_control_ax_cache_push254_audit.lean): 8 named axiom probes, 12 typed callers, and zero warnings. The [independent review](results/arithmetic-control-ax-cache-push254-review.json) checks the source, provider bindings and existing evidence. The first attempt failed because two `simpa` calls did not normalize three literal control aliases. Its source, audit, executed guard, log and result are retained in the [history](results/arithmetic-control-ax-cache-push254-history.json), alongside the three explicit `rfl` equalities used for the successful repair. The earlier final-newline normalization and original uncompiled draft are also preserved. Publication packaging performed no proof replay.

The [guard](check_arithmetic_control_ax_cache_push254.py) reuses the exact [AXPrefix PASS record](results/arithmetic-control-ax-prefix254-verification.json) and its 99 imported project providers. Five external boundaries are directly imported; the separately retained `Foundation.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.HFS.Seq` gives six verified external providers in total, alongside two toolchain boundaries. The guard builds only this source and its audit with a shared 120-second deadline, `-j1 -M4096`, and default proof limits. Its inherited arithmetic binary transport remains the Perm252 transport. This result advances the register interpreter shared with the 246-state target; it does not establish an internal 246 binary transport, the GEN constructor, the remaining AX suffix, or the full PA consistency endpoint.

Preparation and replay require the exact historical cached project and dependency objects, source files and compiler recorded in the evidence. This packet contains source and evidence; it does not distribute those object caches or provide a clean-checkout dependency build. Existing cache identities are checked, and the external dependency closures are not rebuilt.

The shared register program is Mira-Cult's, imported from Jeff's verification; the original TMBuilder framework is Wade's. [Prog254.lean](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/Prog254.lean) records the original source and attribution.

After installing the packet, prepare the exact maintained defaults without compiling:

```bash
python3 -B Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/check_arithmetic_control_ax_cache_push254.py \
  --repo "$PWD" \
  --dependency-root /home/codex/src/Proofs \
  --ax-prefix-evidence "$PWD/Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-ax-prefix254-verification.json" \
  --output /tmp/zfc-ax-cache-push-maintained-prepared \
  --prepare-only
```

A proof replay uses the same command with a fresh empty output directory and without `--prepare-only`. Preparation retains the required parent and dependency arguments, uses installed source/audit defaults, and performs no compiler or compiler-version query. Installed-default preparation is recorded separately after placement; it is not claimed by the original successful proof record.

# Next internal AX contract: the actual cache/P2 push

Source-only proposal. No Lean, compiler, version query, repository checker, or supplied program was run. The separate reviewer-owned literal parser only reads source text. No maintained file was changed. This plan does not add a checked theorem.

The smallest next complete AX subroutine is **catalogue control 67 to control 93**: save the current TW on WS, copy the old cache/P2 into TW, and restore the cache. This extends the already checked `ArithmeticControlAXPrefix254.ax_prefix_run`, whose exit is control 67. It requires no new unbounded-loop proof. Its next semantic milestone is the GEN constructor through control 122, described below so that this small unit has an exact consumer.

All indices below are `FiniteControlTable254.Control` indices, not binary states or structured-DAG node identifiers. `number c` encodes index `c` as `c+1`. Thus the proposed contract runs from represented control 68 to 94. Its control graph is the existing literal `Prog254`, shared by the arithmetic interpreter; it is not a new 246-state binary transport theorem.

## Exact theorem to implement first

Work with arbitrary `V`, `[ORingStructure V]`, and `[V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]`, exactly as the existing AX prefix, Pair, Read, and MP modules. The input `file : V`, every register value, and the existential duration are internal elements of `V`.

Proposed names and statement, not yet declarations:

```lean
def cachePop : Control := ⟨93, by decide⟩

def cachePushFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file cacheReg)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem ax_cache_push_run (file : V)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time
        (liveValue (number ArithmeticControlAXPrefix254.nextPush : V) file) =
      liveValue (number cachePop : V) (cachePushFile file)
```

This endpoint changes only TW and WS. It preserves NP, PL, AC, P1, cache/P2 and both scratch fields; the latter therefore remain zero. There is no premise that TW, WS, cache, or the duration is a standard numeral, a formula code, bounded by external fuel, or reachable from the blank tape. No extra cleanliness assumptions are hidden in a record predicate.

The logical-to-physical positions are important: TW logical 1 → physical 2; WS logical 2 → physical 0; P1 logical 4 → physical 3; cache/P2 logical 5 → physical 7; S1 logical 6 → physical 8; S2 logical 7 → physical 5; PL logical 8 → physical 1; AC logical 3 → physical 4; NP logical 0 → physical 6. These are the existing `Permutation252Frame.physOf` values, not a renaming of that binary frame as 246.

## Literal shape bindings

The full paths, instruction tags, positive/zero/continue/break targets and represented numbers for controls 41–136 are in `literal-bindings.json`. They were reconstructed from every literal `Prog254` row and independently matched against all 6,460 leaves of `ActualTree254.tree`. This is source-text evidence, not a Lean proof of the following shape instances.

| New finite shape | Control fields | Logical registers | Exact exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| first `MoveShape` | test 67, increment 68, again 69 | TW → S1 | 70 |
| second `MoveShape` | test 70, increment 71, again 72 | WS → TW | 73 |
| pairing `CopyShape` | test 73, firstInc 74, secondInc 75, again 76 | TW → S2 and S1 | 77 |
| pairing `MoveShape` | test 79, increment 80, again 81 | S1 → TW | 82 |
| `PairShape` | copy above; testS1 77, incS2 78, move above, again 82 | existing fixed Pair fields | 83 |
| output `MoveShape` | test 83, increment 84, again 85 | S2 → WS | 86 |
| cache `CopyShape` | test 86, firstInc 87, secondInc 88, again 89 | cache → TW and S1 | 90 |
| restore `MoveShape` | test 90, increment 91, again 92 | S1 → cache | 93 |

The first six rows assemble an `ArithmeticControlParamPush254.PushShape`. In the two Pair rows, test 77 has positive target 78 and zero target 83; 78 continues to 79, and 82 returns to 73. These are actual control occurrences, so copying a theorem about the MP occurrence or merely shifting a numerical start control would not suffice.

`ArithmeticControlParamPush254.ParamPushShape` is **hardwired to `p1Reg`**. It cannot be instantiated for cache/P2 as it stands. The narrow implementation should retain that existing API and directly compose `push_run`, a cache-specific `copy_run` instance, and a cache-specific `move_run` instance. A new general parameter-push abstraction is optional later; it is unnecessary for this contract.

## Existing proof APIs and composition

Use these exact public declarations:

- `ArithmeticControlParamPush254.PushShape`, `pushFile`, `push_run` (`ArithmeticControlParamPush254.lean:25,109,112`). The output of the push is TW = 0, WS = `cantor oldTW oldWS`, with every other field unchanged.
- `ArithmeticControlPair254.CopyShape`, `copy_run` (`ArithmeticControlPair254.lean:46,331`). Its exact clock is `4 * source + 1`; its endpoint zeros the source and adds the old source to each distinct target.
- `ArithmeticControlPair254.MoveShape`, `move_run` (`ArithmeticControlPair254.lean:25,236`). Its exact clock is `3 * source + 1`; its endpoint zeros the source and adds it to the target.
- `ArithmeticControlPair254.PairShape`, `pair_run` (`ArithmeticControlPair254.lean:76,474`) is already used by `push_run`; do not reprove pairing totality.
- `ArithmeticControlRun254.controlRun_add` and `controlRun_succ` (`ArithmeticControlRun254.lean:60,56`) compose the actual internal clocks.
- `ArithmeticControlStep254.write_at`, `write_other`, `file_reg`; `ArithmeticControlClear254.write_overwrite`, `ArithmeticControlFrame254.write_same`; and `ArithmeticControlFetch254.put` handle equality of the complete nine-register file. The useful read/write commutation and extensionality helpers in ParamPush/MP are private, so a new module must prove its short local versions or use these public underlying declarations.

First derive a small exact-clock tail lemma at control 86:

```lean
-- Proposed statement; cacheCopy is the new CopyShape with test 86.
-- Only S1=0 is needed. S2 and the other unrelated fields may be arbitrary.
controlRun (7 * regValue file cacheReg + 2)
  (liveValue (number cacheCopy.test : V) file) =
  liveValue (number cachePop : V)
    (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file cacheReg) file)
```

Its proof is `copy_run` at 86 followed by `move_run` at 90. With `h := regValue file cacheReg`, the intermediate whole file is

```text
put S1 h (put TW (oldTW+h) (put cache 0 file)).
```

The restore costs `3*h+1`; the copy costs `4*h+1`. Their combined endpoint restores cache to `h` and S1 to its original zero. Compose that tail with `push_run`; the old cache is preserved by `pushFile`, and TW is zero there. The total clock can stay existential as `t_push + (7*h+2)`.

Direct imports for this first unit can be just `BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXPrefix254`; its transitive imports already expose the listed Push/Move/Copy APIs. Do not import the ordinary-Nat L2 development as a proof dependency. A strict runner must inventory the actual imported closure against checked provider objects when implementation is ready; this plan has not prepared or executed such a runner.

## Internal loop invariants already supplied by those APIs

No new induction is necessary for the proposed unit. These are the invariants it reuses, with the original file fixed before induction:

- At a Move test after `t ≤ n` iterations: source `n-t`, target `oldTarget+t`, exact elapsed clock `3*t`; every other field is fixed.
- At a Copy test after `t ≤ n` iterations: source `n-t`, targets `oldFirst+t` and `oldSecond+t`, exact clock `4*t`; every other field is fixed.
- At the Pair copy-test, with fixed `N := oldS1+oldTW` and `Q := oldS2+cantor oldS1 oldTW`: for each internal `t ≤ N`, there are internal `time,a,b,z` such that the current file is `pairFile original a b z`, `a+b+t=N`, and `z+cantor a b=Q`. The witness variables are existential inside the Σ₁ induction predicate. This is the proof of `pair_run`; all starting register values can be nonstandard.

For the proposed cache push these specialize to: TW→S1, WS→TW, pairing into S2, S2→WS, then cache→TW/S1 and S1→cache. The private exact file names used inside old proofs are not required by a new caller. In particular, do not replace these invariants by induction on an external Nat clock or by `∀ file, ∃ time` inside a claimed Σ₁ induction predicate.

## Immediate consumer: the first GEN constructor

The next independent constructor unit is **control 93 → control 122**. This is an actual universal-formula constructor on arbitrary codes, not a proof that its output is a valid generalization instance.

| Operation | Actual controls | Reused API |
|---|---|---|
| unpair WS into S1 and WS | read 93; body 94–100; restore 101–103; exit 104 | `ArithmeticControlUnpairCore254.UnpairCoreShape`, `core_run` at line 308, with main logical 2 / physical 0 |
| pair S1 and TW into S2 | copy 104–107, testS1 108, incS2 109, move 110–112, again 113, exit 114 | `ArithmeticControlPair254.pair_run` |
| multiply by four into TW | test 114, inc1…inc4 = 115…118, again 119, exit 120 | `ArithmeticControlMP254.Scale4Shape`, `scale_run` at line 158 |
| add tag 2 | inc TW at 120 and 121; exit 122 | `ArithmeticControlSimulation254.step_inc`, `controlRun_succ` |

The proposed standalone constructor endpoint is

```text
∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
  controlRun time (live(number 93, file)) =
  live(number 122,
    put TW (ArithmeticCode254.wal (first oldWS) oldTW)
      (put WS (second oldWS) file)).
```

It assumes only the two scratch-zero premises and preserves every other coordinate. The pop temporarily leaves `first oldWS` in S1; Pair consumes S1 and TW and leaves `cantor (first oldWS) oldTW` in S2; Scale4 zeros S2 and sets TW to four times that value; the two increments add the universal tag. `ArithmeticCode254.wal` is exactly `4*cantor a b+2`, not an uninterpreted constructor.

The pop loop's existing `UnpairCore254.walk_reach` invariant is: after `t ≤ oldWS` outer iterations, for some internal time, WS is `oldWS-t`, S1 is `first t`, S2 is `second t`, with other fields unchanged. `core_run` restores `second oldWS` to WS and keeps `first oldWS` in S1. The Pair invariant above then applies with arbitrary initial S1; it does not require S1 zero. Scale4 uses source `n-t`, target `oldTW+4*t`, clock `6*t` and exits after `6*n+1`. Thus the constructor also needs no new unbounded induction.

The checked whole MP theorem `mp_run` is not a substitute: it includes an MP-specific occurrence, comparison, cache effects, and branch exit. Reuse its **generic** `Scale4Shape/scale_run`, together with UnpairCore and Pair, at the AX occurrence.

After cache-push plus this constructor, controls **67 → 122** have the particularly simple endpoint

